journey.name: Wear - Launch and Landing
journey.description:
Verifies that the watch app opens on its landing screen and that each of the three entry points (Home, Messages, New post) opens its destination and comes back to the landing screen, and that going back from the landing screen leaves the app.
Run on a round Wear OS emulator with the bench build (no phone, fictional data). Start with the app stopped. Commands for every step are in docs/wear-testing.md.

actions.action: Launch Nubecita on the watch with the bench scenario "default"
Verify that the landing screen is shown with the title "Nubecita" and three buttons: Home, Messages and New post
Verify that the Messages button shows an unread count of 2
Verify that the clock at the top of the screen is visible and does not overlap the title
Verify that the feed is shown with the header "Following" and a post by Ana Ruiz
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen to go back
Verify that the landing screen is shown
Verify that the conversation list is shown with the title "Messages" and a conversation with Ana Ruiz
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen to go back
Verify that the landing screen is shown
Verify that the system text input screen is shown with the label "New post" and the voice and keyboard choices
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen to go back
Verify that the landing screen is shown
Swipe right from the left edge of the screen to go back
Verify that Nubecita is no longer on screen
